name: Jefferson County, AL
findings: Jefferson County has 2,803 nonprofit organizations. 1,037 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 790 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Jefferson County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Research and think tank organizations stand out for public events
observations.text: 29 research and think tank organizations here list public events, compared with about 12 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 29 organizations here; 39% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What role do research and think tank organizations play in community life here? Who do they reach, and who might they miss?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 234 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.

confidence.text: Based on 234 organizations here; 39% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Few housing organizations list public events
observations.text: 4 housing organizations here list public events. In similar places of this size, about 9 would.

confidence.text: Based on 9 organizations here; 39% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for public events through housing groups? Where else does that happen?
